generalizations: This is an original day-phase decision diagram, not a timetable or opening-hours chart.
Morning, midday, afternoon, and evening are broad traveler decisions rather than exact hours.
The afternoon branches are alternatives; the diagram does not ask the traveler to complete both.
Availability, closing time, portions, recipes, dietary status, and exact locations require a live check.

notes: The 1620 x 2280 print diagram and compiled B6 page preserve four broad day phases, the single afternoon branch, the missed-morning fallback, and the evening stop without clipping or collisions.
At a 390 px viewport the 760 px stage pans left, centre, and right; both afternoon choices and every route warning remain readable with visible zoom and reset controls.
